messages:
maria.k: quick sync — we need a compact checklist for post-launch SEO cleanup after the webinar landing goes live tomorrow. main asks: redirects, schema, internal links, and canonical checks. who can own each?
josh.c: I can take keyword sanity and onpage copy tuning. will do quick SERP check for 10 target phrases.
devon.w: I’ll handle redirects + 301 sweep. can you drop the current redirect map? i’ll diff against old page paths.
maria.k: attaching draft redirect map (see link) — https://drive.redwood/example-redirect-map : please comment inline by EOD.
tamika.p: assigning owners: devon = redirects, josh = keywords & meta, maria = schema + analytics tagging. seo-bot: reminder: run structured-data-testing on /webinar-signup after changes. :robot_face:
josh.c: plan for keywords: primary + 3 longtails each. short meta title variants so we can A/B quickly. will add to content doc.
devon.w: redirect checklist snippet i’ll run:
```
1) export current Nginx rewrite rules
2) run linkfinder across prev sitemap
3) create 301 map file (old -> new)
4) staged deploy to canary, smoke test 200 -> 301 mapping
```
maria.k: schema checklist: webinarEvent, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage for conf Qs, and speakership items. add LD+JSON on page and og:tags. also ensure eventStatus=Scheduled and startDate in ISO.
tamika.p: also add internal link plan: link from product pages, blog posts, and resources hub. target 3 high-authority anchors per page. can devon output anchor suggestions?
devon.w: yes — i’ll surface top inbound pages from GA and suggest anchors. will include suggested anchor text list.
josh.c: PSA — keep canonical pointing to /webinar-signup (no trailing params). remove any alt canonical tags.
maria.k: analytics/tracking: utm_campaign=webinar_march, set form submit goal, and fire GTM event 'webinar_reg' with email hash. QA: check server logs for 302 vs 301 leaks.
seo-bot: scheduled job: run 'fetch as Google' after 301s; expected recrawl window ~48-72h.
tamika.p: timeline: today — finalize redirect map & schema snippets; tomorrow morning — patch & deploy to canary; tomorrow afternoon — smoke and signoff; 48–72h monitor. owners: devon (redirects, anchors), josh (meta & keywords), maria (schema, QA), tamika (coord).
josh.c: adding canonical + meta draft in /docs/content/webinar-meta.md. will ping when ready.
devon.w: quick question — do we also want a meta refresh fallback for old vanity URLs? might be safer for short timeframe.
maria.k: prefer 301s only. leave meta refresh out unless analytics show drop.
tamika.p: final: please add short checklist items in the doc under "post-launch SEO sweep" and drop thumbs when done. :thumbsup:
maria.k: thanks all — i’ll consolidate and send final check-in at 6pm PST.
